findings.finding: Independent18grouped checks bind seven fixed JSON inputs and four public source copies. Static control-flow and arithmetic are not parser execution, complete MIDI conformance, a current capability census or a GA repair.

The unreachable metadata arm and hypothetical tempo-event delta loss are independent concerns. Correct dispatch alone would not recover erased locations. Modeled projected lists must not be relabeled actual parser output.

Nonnegative header reading yields unsigned high-byte231 and source negation-231, unlike explicit signed-byte decoding-25 followed by positive format25. The750-tick calculation is limited to25non-drop frames/s; no full/drop-frame decoder was validated.

Affine anchors, apparent100ppm and deterministic held-out contradiction are authored assumptions. The incompatible intervals reject the combined affine/coordinate/error model without isolating drift, origin reset or another cause; no synchronization or confidence interval is measured.

Callback times, latency records and80ms gate are invented. Physical string indices are preserved by the selected demonstrator, whose triangle oscillator requests and visual state do not acquire physical onsets. No causal GA improvement or production approval follows.

Dated Web Audio and High Resolution Time documents remain Working Drafts. API timestamp/latency estimates do not measure action-to-acoustic latency or establish actual browser support. Publisher direct403 remains403; separate actual abstract reading does not establish full-paper/PDF/audio access.
Production plan follows initial source reading and hand-worked examples and precedes external numerical verification. It does not claim preregistration of physical/browser experiments.
